Settings v1.2Compound

One Copilot Settings, v1.2 — a two-pane modal with a category sidebar and a content pane. The Sources pane shows a section header (title + Filter-by dropdown + Search), a description with a divider, then source rows (logo + title + secondary + chevron or Connect). Separate from the v1 Settings Modal. Composes Dialog + MenuListItem + Dropdown + Input + Divider.
